description: Defines the BandwidthSampler class and related structures for tracking bandwidth and congestion control in QUIC protocol. Includes classes for sampling bandwidth, tracking acknowledgment height, and managing sent packet states.

classes.name: SendTimeState
classes.description: Represents the send time and state information of a packet, used for bandwidth sampling.

classes.name: ExtraAckedEvent
classes.description: Tracks extra acknowledged bytes and related metrics for bandwidth estimation.

classes.name: BandwidthSample
classes.description: Stores bandwidth and RTT samples at a specific point in time.

classes.name: MaxAckHeightTracker
classes.description: Tracks the maximum acknowledgment height to measure ack aggregation.

classes.name: BandwidthSamplerInterface
classes.description: Interface for classes providing bandwidth samples from acknowledged packets.

classes.name: BandwidthSampler
classes.description: Implements bandwidth sampling logic, tracking sent and acknowledged packets, and estimating bandwidth.

classes.name: AckPoint
classes.description: Represents a point on the acknowledgment timeline with timestamp and total bytes acknowledged.

classes.name: RecentAckPoints
classes.description: Maintains the two most recent acknowledgment points for bandwidth calculations.

methods.name: Update
methods.description: Updates the max acknowledgment height based on current bandwidth estimate and acknowledgment data.

methods.name: SetFilterWindowLength
methods.description: Sets the window length for the acknowledgment height filter.

methods.name: Reset
methods.description: Resets the acknowledgment height filter with new height and time.

methods.name: SetAckAggregationBandwidthThreshold
methods.description: Sets the bandwidth threshold for acknowledgment aggregation.

methods.name: SetStartNewAggregationEpochAfterFullRound
methods.description: Configures whether to start a new acknowledgment aggregation epoch after a full round.

methods.name: SetReduceExtraAckedOnBandwidthIncrease
methods.description: Configures whether to reduce extra acknowledged bytes on bandwidth increase.

methods.name: IsOverestimateAvoidanceEnabled
methods.description: Checks if overestimate avoidance is enabled.

methods.name: OnPacketSent
methods.description: Records a sent packet into the bandwidth sampler.

methods.name: OnPacketNeutered
methods.description: Removes a packet from tracking when neutered.

methods.name: OnCongestionEvent
methods.description: Processes acknowledgment and loss events to update bandwidth estimates.

methods.name: OnAckEventEnd
methods.description: Finalizes bandwidth estimation after acknowledgment events.

methods.name: RemoveObsoletePackets
methods.description: Removes packets below a certain packet number from tracking.

methods.name: is_app_limited
methods.description: Indicates if the connection is currently app-limited.

methods.name: end_of_app_limited_phase
methods.description: Returns the packet number marking the end of the app-limited phase.
